soru: Okul öncesi ve erken çocukluk eğitiminde artırılmış/sanal gerçeklik kullanımının pedagojik, sağlık, etik ve gizlilik boyutları üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?
istem:
Research question: Okul öncesi ve erken çocukluk eğitiminde artırılmış/sanal gerçeklik kullanımının pedagojik, sağlık, etik ve gizlilik boyutları üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?

Cutoff date: 2026-01-13. Only works published BEFORE this date count.

List the 30 most important works (papers) for this research question that were published before the cutoff date, in order of importance (most important first) — the kind a careful expert survey published right after the cutoff would cite. Give each with its arXiv id and/or DOI.

You MUST research this with web search rather than answer from memory: search for the important works, and verify each listed work's title, publication date and identifier on the web (e.g. arxiv.org, doi.org, the publisher or DBLP page) before including it.

When you are done, reply with ONLY a JSON object in this form (no other text):
{"calismalar": [{"sira": 1, "baslik": "exact title", "yil": 2020, "arxiv_id": "arXiv id or null", "doi": "DOI or null", "gerekce": "one sentence on why this work is important"}]}
with exactly 30 items. If you do not know an identifier, use null instead of guessing.

calismalar.baslik: Could virtual reality applications pose real risks to children and adolescents? A systematic review of ethical issues and concerns
calismalar.gerekce: This is the main systematic review of the ethical, health and psychosocial risks of VR for minors, and it frames the ethics side of the field.

calismalar.baslik: Considering virtual reality in children's lives
calismalar.gerekce: A foundational agenda-setting paper linking immersive VR features such as embodiment, virtual characters and settings to child development.

calismalar.baslik: Learning from the real and the virtual worlds: Educational use of augmented reality in early childhood
calismalar.gerekce: Grounds AR for young children in developmental psychology, covering transfer between screen and real world and the line between fantasy and reality, and gives design guidance.

calismalar.baslik: Augmented Reality for Early Language Learning: A Systematic Review of Augmented Reality Application Design, Instructional Strategies, and Evaluation Outcomes
calismalar.gerekce: A systematic review of 53 studies that maps AR design and teaching strategies for early literacy and language learning.

calismalar.baslik: Effects of immersive virtual reality headset viewing on young children: Visuomotor function, postural stability, and motion sickness
calismalar.gerekce: A key clinical study of headset safety in children aged 4–10, measuring vision, balance and motion sickness.

calismalar.baslik: Safety of virtual reality use in children: a systematic review
calismalar.gerekce: Pulls together the paediatric safety evidence and identifies the open problems: little safety guidance for young children and no validated symptom measures.

calismalar.baslik: Virtual reality's effect on children's inhibitory control, social compliance, and sharing
calismalar.gerekce: An experiment with 4–6-year-olds showing that immersive VR, compared with TV, weakens inhibitory control and changes social behaviour.

calismalar.baslik: Virtually true: Children's acquisition of false memories in virtual reality
calismalar.gerekce: Early evidence that VR can create false memories in preschoolers, which is a central developmental and ethical concern.

calismalar.baslik: Embedding immersive virtual reality in classrooms: Ethical, organisational and educational lessons in bridging research and practice
calismalar.gerekce: A field-based account of the ethical, safety and organisational issues that come up when bringing immersive VR into schools.

calismalar.baslik: Educational magic toys developed with augmented reality technology for early childhood education
calismalar.gerekce: A highly cited AR study in preschool settings showing children like AR toys but do not reach high cognitive attainment with them.

calismalar.baslik: Are augmented reality picture books magic or real for preschool children aged five to six?
calismalar.gerekce: A key study of AR picture books, preschoolers' attitudes, story comprehension, and the sense that the books are 'magic'.

calismalar.baslik: Understanding Parents' Perceptions and Practices Toward Children's Security and Privacy in Virtual Reality
calismalar.gerekce: An IEEE S&P study showing parents underestimate VR data-collection risks to children and rarely use parental controls.

calismalar.baslik: Cyborg Children: A Systematic Literature Review on the Experience of Children Using Extended Reality
calismalar.gerekce: A recent systematic review of children's XR experiences across developmental, social and wellbeing dimensions.

calismalar.baslik: The impact of fantasy on young children's recall: A virtual reality approach
calismalar.gerekce: Preregistered experiments in which preschoolers using headsets recalled less than those using desktop VR, which raises the cognitive-load question for immersive VR.

calismalar.baslik: Immersive virtual reality interferes with default head–trunk coordination strategies in young children
calismalar.gerekce: Shows that immersive VR changes postural and sensorimotor control in children, a developmental health concern.

calismalar.baslik: Children and parents' reading of an augmented reality picture book: Analyses of behavioral patterns and cognitive attainment
calismalar.gerekce: A foundational study of parent–child shared reading with AR books and how interaction patterns relate to learning.

calismalar.baslik: Augmented reality-based virtual manipulatives versus physical manipulatives for teaching geometric shapes to preschool children
calismalar.gerekce: A rare controlled comparison of AR and physical manipulatives for preschool maths.

calismalar.baslik: Advantages and challenges associated with augmented reality for education: A systematic review of the literature
calismalar.gerekce: The most cited general review of AR's benefits and challenges in education, used as a reference point by early childhood studies.

calismalar.baslik: Using Augmented Reality in early art education: a case study in Hong Kong kindergarten
calismalar.gerekce: A design-based kindergarten study recording benefits along with concerns from teachers, principal and parents about AR side effects.

calismalar.baslik: Augmented reality for preschool children: An experience with educational contents
calismalar.gerekce: A quasi-experimental study reporting gains in motivation, attention and concept skills among 4–5-year-olds.

calismalar.baslik: Integration of Augmented Reality in the Teaching of English as a Foreign Language in Early Childhood Education
calismalar.gerekce: A key study of AR for foreign-language teaching in early childhood classrooms.

calismalar.baslik: The Ethics of Realism in Virtual and Augmented Reality
calismalar.gerekce: An influential paper on the ethical risks of highly realistic VR/AR, including risks to vulnerable users such as children.

calismalar.baslik: Unique Identification of 50,000+ Virtual Reality Users from Head & Hand Motion Data
calismalar.gerekce: Shows that VR motion data can identify users and infer their traits, which underpins privacy concerns about children's XR data.

calismalar.baslik: Exploring the Perspectives of Social VR-Aware Non-Parent Adults and Parents on Children's Use of Social Virtual Reality
calismalar.gerekce: Documents abuse, age-inappropriate exposure, self-disclosure and supervision gaps for children in social VR.

calismalar.baslik: A Virtual Space for All: Exploring Children's Experience in Social Virtual Reality
calismalar.gerekce: Pioneering empirical work on children's presence and safety issues in social VR.

calismalar.baslik: Asking ethical questions in research using immersive virtual and augmented reality technologies with children and youth
calismalar.gerekce: Sets out procedural and in-practice ethics frameworks for XR research with children.

calismalar.baslik: How Real is Augmented Reality in Preschool? Examination of Young Children's AR Experiences
calismalar.gerekce: A qualitative kindergarten study showing AR can both focus and distract young children.

calismalar.baslik: Real Virtuality: A Code of Ethical Conduct. Recommendations for Good Scientific Practice and the Consumers of VR-Technology
calismalar.gerekce: A foundational VR ethics code that flags long-term immersion risks and the special vulnerability of children.

calismalar.baslik: Meta-analysis of the impact of Augmented Reality on students' learning gains
calismalar.gerekce: A widely cited meta-analysis of AR learning effects across education levels, including early ones.

calismalar.baslik: Social Virtual Reality: Ethical Considerations and Future Directions for An Emerging Research Space
calismalar.gerekce: Sets out the ethical and privacy research agenda for social VR, including the protection of minors.
